# Fix BFS + systematically visit all untried positions, checking for win after each.
def ballpos(fr, color='N'):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and n['pixels']==4:
            b=n['boundary']
            return (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))

valid=set()
for r in range(30,38,2):
    for c in [8,10]: valid.add((r,c))
for r in range(38,44,2):
    for c in [8,10,12]: valid.add((r,c))
tried={(30,8),(30,10),(36,10),(40,10),(42,10)}
remaining=sorted(valid-tried)

from collections import deque
def neighbors(r,c):
    out=[]
    for dr,dc,mv in [(-2,0,'UP'),(2,0,'DOWN'),(0,-2,'LEFT'),(0,2,'RIGHT')]:
        if (r+dr,c+dc) in valid: out.append(((r+dr,c+dc),mv))
    return out

start=(36,10)
q=deque([(start,[])])
seen={start}
order=[]
while q:
    pos,path=q.popleft()
    if pos not in tried: order.append((pos,path))
    for np_,mv in neighbors(*pos):
        if np_ not in seen:
            seen.add(np_); q.append((np_,path+[mv]))
print("visit order:", [(p,pa) for p,pa in order])

# Now execute: visit each remaining position, stop if win
cur=ballpos(current_frame)
print("start at", cur)
for target,path in order:
    # path is from start (36,10); but we may not be at start. Recompute: just do path from current via BFS
    # simpler: BFS from current to target
    q2=deque([(cur,[])]); seen2={cur}; found=None
    while q2:
        p2,pth2=q2.popleft()
        if p2==target: found=pth2; break
        for np_,mv in neighbors(*p2):
            if np_ not in seen2:
                seen2.add(np_); q2.append((np_,pth2+[mv]))
    if found is None:
        print("no path to",target); continue
    res=action(found)
    cur=ballpos(current_frame)
    done=last_action_result.get('done'); lvl=last_action_result.get('level_completed')
    print(f"-> {target} path={found} now={cur} done={done} lvl={lvl}")
    if done or lvl:
        print("WON!"); break
    if cur!=target:
        print("  !! did not reach target"); break

</function>
</tool_call>
